title: Rav Acha son of Rav Ashi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Zevachim 91a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.91a.17), raising a difficulty against Ravina; Hyman proposes the reading Rav Acha son of Rava, as in Dikdukei Soferim. In [Chullin 97b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.97b.3-4), where Rav Acha son of Rav Ashi disagrees with Ravina, he proposes the reading there as “bar Rav,” according to the reading of the She’iltot, Vayishlach; Dikdukei Soferim likewise reports corruption in the Venice printing. Hyman identifies the Ravina who disagrees with him as the later Ravina.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Zevachim has Rav Acha son of Rav Ashi. Hyman gives Rav Acha son of Rava as the Dikdukei Soferim reading.
Chullin names Acha bar Rav Ashi and then Acha bar Rav in two exchanges with Ravina. Hyman’s proposed Venice printing history and identification of the later Ravina remain his conclusions.
